aboutPage.tagline: Light up your world · Ready to play on launch
aboutPage.licenseHint: GPL-3.0-only with Section 7 brand protection terms
aboutPage.licenseSummary: Lumi source code is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0-only). Modified distributions must remain open source under the same license and preserve copyright and third-party notices.
aboutPage.licenseBrandBody: Modified distributions must be clearly marked as modified and must not reuse the names “Lumi”, “Lumi Launcher”, or “微光”, nor the official Lumi app icon or illustrations, in a way that implies official affiliation.
aboutPage.privacyHint: Sign-in goes directly to official services; refresh tokens stay isolated in Windows Credential Manager.
aboutPage.privacyAuth: Microsoft sign-in opens in your system browser. Before launching, Lumi verifies Java Edition play rights and the official Java profile directly through official Microsoft and Minecraft services.
aboutPage.privacyCredentials: Refresh tokens are stored per account in Windows Credential Manager (or memory only if unavailable). The game session credential is delivered to Java over its standard input pipe and excluded from command lines, temporary files, UI events, and exported diagnostics.
aboutPage.privacyRemoval: Removing an account revokes its launch authorization and clears local credentials while keeping all instances, mods, and worlds intact.
aboutPage.credit_modrinth: Open platform for mods, modpacks, resource packs, and shaders powering search, dependencies, and updates.
aboutPage.credit_curseforge: Mod and modpack ecosystem; Lumi strictly respects authors’ third-party download settings via manual claim.
aboutPage.creditsFootnote: Official sources always remain the authority for game files and authentication. Lumi is not affiliated with any listed service.
aboutPage.thirdPartyHint: {{count}} direct open-source dependencies and references documented.
aboutPage.thirdPartyFootnote: Each component's full license text ships with its source code; the project's own license file is authoritative.
